production_teams.hero_desc: Keep departments aligned and work moving from prep to wrap. Pzaz brings scheduling, tasks, communication and files into one shared workspace so production teams can stay organised without adding more process.
production_teams.problem_title_a: Bring order to the realities of production.
production_teams.problem_desc: Production teams work under constant pressure, balancing evolving plans, limited time and coordination across multiple departments. When information lives in separate tools, small misalignments can quickly turn into delays.
production_teams.problem_card_h: The friction that compounds across every shoot.
production_teams.problem_p1: Schedules, tasks and communication live in separate tools
production_teams.problem_p2: Updates get lost between departments and slow momentum
production_teams.problem_p3: Files and scripts are scattered, making access unreliable
production_teams.problem_p4: No single view of progress across the production
production_teams.problem_summary: Pzaz centralises the moving parts so updates, decisions and responsibilities remain visible to everyone.
production_teams.promise_h3: Tools Designed Around How Production Actually Works.
production_teams.promise_p: Support collaboration without slowing the crew down.
production_teams.promise_desc: Production workflows are fast, practical and often unpredictable. The tools supporting them need to be clear, flexible and reliable rather than overly complex.

prod_teams.tools_title: Tools Designed for Real Production Workflows
prod_teams.tools_desc: Support storytelling that moves fast. Pzaz provides a system that supports production realities without constraining day-to-day execution.
prod_teams.tool1_desc: Crew members can communicate directly within projects so discussions remain tied to tasks and decisions rather than scattered across external platforms.
prod_teams.tool1_highlight: Keep conversations connected to the work.
prod_teams.tool2_desc: Task boards provide a simple way to track progress, adjust responsibilities and ensure that everyone understands what needs to happen next.
prod_teams.tool3_desc: Updates to schedules, tasks or production plans are shared instantly, helping teams respond quickly without unnecessary disruption.
prod_teams.tool3_highlight: Stay aware of changes as they happen.
prod_teams.tool4_desc: Documents, images and reference materials can be stored and shared within the same environment, making it easier for departments to access what they need.
prod_teams.tool4_highlight: Keep scripts and production materials organised.
prod_teams.add_desc: More tools that keep crews connected, informed and accountable.
prod_teams.add1_desc: Teams can update plans and documents simultaneously, allowing production decisions to move forward without waiting for handovers.
prod_teams.add2_desc: Directors and producers can monitor progress, budgets and scheduling within a single environment that reflects the realities of production.
prod_teams.add2_highlight: Maintain visibility across the entire project.
prod_teams.add3_desc: Crew members can shape their view of tasks, timelines and updates so they focus on what matters most to their responsibilities.
prod_teams.cta_h2: Ready to Keep Your Production Team Aligned?
prod_teams.cta_p: Give your crew one connected workspace so communication, tasks and schedules stay in sync from prep through to wrap.
